name: YOOAdmin
author: YOOPixel

sections.description:
YOOAdmin upgrades the default WordPress admin experience with a cleaner interface, smarter organization, and productivity-focused tools.

Built by professionals with years of real client experience, YOOAdmin helps site owners, freelancers, agencies, and teams work faster inside wp-admin without touching WordPress core files.

Whether you manage one site or many, YOOAdmin gives you a more focused and professional workspace.

Core Features

  • Modern and clean admin interface
  • Turns distracting admin banners into clean notifications you can review anytime
  • Focus Mode for distraction-free work
  • Custom dashboard with quick actions
  • Custom branding (logo, title, colors)
  • Improved Posts, Pages, Categories and Tags views
  • Enhanced Users pages and profiles
  • Better admin menu organization
  • Theme and color customization
  • Translation ready with WordPress.org language support
  • Safe optional full data cleanup tool
  • Works with multisite
  • No frontend impact
  • Fully reversible using WordPress hooks

Notification Engine

YOOAdmin transforms cluttered admin banners and notices into a clean notification center.

Important messages stay accessible, your dashboard stays focused, and your workspace remains organized.

Focus Mode

Reduce clutter and stay productive.

Focus Mode helps simplify the admin area by minimizing distractions and improving clarity while you work.

Branding & Customization

Make the dashboard feel like your own workspace:

  • Upload custom logo
  • Change colors
  • Customize dashboard appearance
  • Improve client-facing admin experience

Optional Account Connection

YOOAdmin works fully without connecting any external account.

You may optionally connect your website to a YOOAdmin account for account linking and status verification only.

Connecting an account does not disable or unlock core plugin features.

Privacy

If you choose to connect an account, the plugin may communicate with yooadmin.io for verification purposes.

This may include:

  • Website URL
  • Server IP address

No personal data, visitor data, analytics, or user tracking data is collected.

Privacy Policy:
https://yooadmin.io/privacy-policy/

Terms of Service:
https://yooadmin.io/terms-of-service/

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect personal data by default.

If account connection is used, website URL and server IP may be used only for verification.

Full policy:
https://yooadmin.io/privacy-policy/

Support

Documentation:

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/yooadmin, or install through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. After activation, the setup wizard opens automatically.
  4. Complete the quick setup steps.
  5. Start using your new workspace.
sections.faq:
Is YOOAdmin free?

Yes. All core features included in this version are free.

Do I need to connect an account?

No. The plugin works fully without any connection.

Does it modify WordPress core files?

No. YOOAdmin uses standard WordPress hooks and can be removed cleanly.

Does it slow down my website?

No. It runs only inside the admin dashboard and does not affect the frontend.

Can I use it on client websites?

Yes.

Does it support multisite?

Yes.

Is YOOAdmin translation ready?

Yes. YOOAdmin follows WordPress localization standards and supports community translations through WordPress.org.

Is my data tracked?

No user tracking or analytics data is collected.

Does YOOAdmin leave data behind after removal?

No. YOOAdmin includes an optional cleanup tool that can remove plugin settings, notifications, and custom tables safely.
